verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a state business-filing portal, since bulk annual-report filing or bulk record actions are plausible, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes only single-entity actions: one annual report, one amendment, one reinstatement or dissolution at a time. Nothing shows a way to act on many entities or filings at once. The prepaid Sunbiz E-File Account is a payment option, not a bulk-operation capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
